narration: दोनों दीवारों पर खरगोश बैठे हैं। दरवाज़े जितने बड़े।
caption: A rabbit sits on each of the two walls. As big as the door.
image_brief: Both bedroom walls carrying a large rabbit shadow, the space between them dark, the paper-tube lamp low on the floor.

narration: कान छत तक पहुँच रहे हैं। किनारे बिलकुल साफ़ हैं।
caption: The ears are reaching the ceiling. The edges are perfectly sharp.
image_brief: Two tall shadow ears rising up one wall to the line where it meets the ceiling, their edges crisp.

narration: छोटी खिलखिलाकर हँसती है और बिस्तर पर बैठ जाती है।
caption: The little one bursts into giggles and sits up in bed.
image_brief: The younger sister sitting up laughing with her hands on the blanket, her own lit wall behind her.

narration: पारो उँगली मोड़ती है। दोनों खरगोश साथ में कान हिलाते हैं।
caption: Paro bends a finger. Both rabbits flick their ears together.
image_brief: One of Paro's fingers bent over in the beam, and the folded ear shape repeated on the wall behind.

narration: पारो थाली घुमाती है। खरगोश एक दीवार से दूसरी पर कूद जाता है।
caption: Paro turns the plate. The rabbit jumps from one wall to the other.
image_brief: Paro's hand swivelling the steel plate while a bright streak sweeps across the room from one wall to the other.

narration: छोटी हर कूद पर ताली बजाती है। कमरा हँसी से भर गया।
caption: The little one claps at every jump. The room filled with laughter.
image_brief: The younger sister clapping on her bed with her mouth open in a laugh, shadow ears above her.

narration: अब खरगोश छोटी के तकिए के ठीक ऊपर बैठा है।
caption: Now the rabbit sits right above the little one's pillow.
image_brief: A rabbit shadow resting on the wall directly over the younger sister's pillow, her head settling below it.

narration: पारो थाली को वहीं थाम लेती है। हिलने नहीं देती।
caption: Paro holds the plate right there. She lets it move no further.
image_brief: Paro's fingers gripping the rim of the steel plate to hold it still against the wall.

narration: पारो और छोटी ने एक साथ कहा, दो ताली, एक खरगोश!
caption: Paro and her little sister said it together, two claps, one rabbit!
image_brief: Both girls with their palms pressed together mid-clap, facing each other across the dark room, shadows on both walls.

narration: अब एक खरगोश दो दीवारों का है।
caption: Now one rabbit belongs to two walls.
image_brief: One frame holding both walls, the same rabbit shape on each, the paper-tube lamp glowing between them.

narration: छोटी की पलकें झपकने लगीं। खरगोश उसके तकिए पर बैठा रहा।
caption: The little one's eyelids began to droop. The rabbit stayed over her pillow.
image_brief: The younger sister's eyes closing on her pillow, the rabbit shadow steady on the wall above her hair.

narration: पारो को यही सबसे अच्छा लगा। कमरा भरा भरा लगता है।
caption: This was what Paro liked best. The room feels full now.
image_brief: Paro sitting on the floor turning her head to take in the dark room with a shadow rabbit on either side.

narration: पारो मुस्कुराती है। उसकी दीवार भी अब खाली नहीं है।
caption: Paro smiles. Her own wall is not empty any more.
image_brief: Paro smiling with the rabbit shadow on her own wall rising just behind her shoulder.

narration: पारो कंबल में सरक गई। दोनों दीवारों पर कान अब भी खड़े हैं।
caption: Paro slid under her blanket. The ears still stand on both walls.
image_brief: Paro tucked under her blanket on her low bed, shadow ears standing tall on the wall at each side of the room.

narration: पारो ने आँखें मूँदीं और धीरे से कहा, दो ताली, एक खरगोश!
caption: Paro closed her eyes and said softly, two claps, one rabbit!
image_brief: Paro's face with closed eyes resting on her pillow, a faint rabbit shadow on the wall above her head.
